name: The Sanctum of the Fallen God

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: Deep in the drowned temple, the seeker reaches the Sanctum of the Fallen God. Atal’ai bloodrinkers stand among the threats within its halls; the Mosh’aru tablets and Ancient Egg frame Yeh’kinya’s rite. The deep waters hold their silence as the summoning begins.
